description: This file defines interfaces and data structures related to command sources and status checks within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, including the 'MonitorCommand' struct and 'CommandSource' and 'StatusCheckCommandSource' classes.

classes.name: CommandSource
classes.description: An interface for providing a list of monitor commands, inheriting from SetupFeature.

classes.name: StatusCheckCommandSource
classes.description: An interface extending CommandSource for checking the availability status.

methods.name: Commands
methods.description: Returns a list of MonitorCommand objects.

methods.name: WaitForAvailability
methods.description: Waits until the status check indicates availability.
